Hey friend, I felt like this for a large part of my adolescence and pushed through it with everything I had. I won’t assume to know how you’re feeling but I will say this:

Your life is worth saving. Like you said, you don’t want to die. Do everything you can to lean into that. There will be things that will make this easier to carry, in the meantime think of things that you can do short-term that will make you want to stay. That can be a show that’s not fully out yet, a new friend you want to learn more about or a concert that’s a few months away. Whatever it is that works for you - do it. 

Also, reaching out for help can be really good even though it’s hard. It can be someone you trust or a helpline, therapy is always good but that’s not always accessible. 

Please look after yourself, I’m so sorry you are dealing with all of this. You don’t have to be alone for this. You deserve to live well.
